evals.name: new-context-cqs-split
evals.prompt: Preciso criar uma feature de cobranças (charges) no nosso serviço. Endpoint pra criar uma cobrança e outro pra listar as cobranças de um cliente.
evals.expected_output: contexts/charges/ with single controller, use-cases/create-charge.use-case.ts (Input/Output/class, returns minimal Output), services/charges.query-service.ts injecting DataSource, flat domain/ with entity, value objects and ChargeRepository abstract class, adapters/ with TypeORM repository, module wiring with provide/useClass
assertions: States the chosen architecture level before the code
Uses src/contexts/charges/ layout, not global controllers/services folders
Value objects and the port are files directly in domain/, with no value-objects/ or ports/ subfolder
Create action is a dedicated use-case file with Input, Output and class together
Create returns a minimal Output (the id), not the whole aggregate
List action is in a query service under services/, NOT a repository method
Query service injects TypeORM DataSource directly and caps the page size
Port is declared as abstract class, not interface, with no Symbol token and no @Inject()
Business errors are returned inline as Result.Err({ type, message }), not thrown and not error classes
Controller maps DTO to Input explicitly and returns the use-case Result as-is, with no if on isErr and no status mapping
Result → HTTP translation happens in a global ResultInterceptor + BusinessErrorFilter registered via APP_INTERCEPTOR / APP_FILTER, using the BUSINESS_ERROR_STATUS map
Module wires port to adapter via { provide: X, useClass: Y }

evals.name: code-style-guard-clauses
evals.prompt: Escreve o use-case de bloquear conta: recebe accountId e motivo, busca a conta, se não existir retorna erro, se já estiver bloqueada retorna erro, senão bloqueia e salva.
evals.expected_output: Level-1 use-case: started log, guard clauses with braces returning Result.Err inline, block transition on the entity (tell don't ask), save, finished log, Result.Ok(); no log-and-rethrow try/catch
assertions: Every if has opening and closing braces; no single-line if
No else anywhere in the use-case
No nested if; method stays at one indentation level
Guard clauses return early, one condition per guard, with the happy path at the bottom
The 'already blocked' rule lives in the Account entity (account.block() returns Result), not in the use-case reading status
Guards use `if (x.isErr) { return x; }` with the narrowed Err returned as-is
No inline comments; only docstrings if any
Logs are inline structured objects via injected Logger with the class name as context
Command returns Result<void, BusinessError> and succeeds with Result.Ok()
No try/catch that only logs and rethrows; infrastructure failures propagate to the global filter

evals.name: outbox-pubsub-idempotency
evals.prompt: Quando o boleto é pago a gente precisa avisar o serviço de ledger e o de notificações. Como implemento isso?
evals.expected_output: Aggregate records event, repository drains it to the outbox in the same transaction, relay with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED publishes envelope to SNS, one SQS queue per consumer, consumers in workers/ that dedupe by eventId marking processed only after success, idempotent operations
assertions: Event is written to the outbox in the same transaction as the state change, drained by the repository
Does not use an in-process event handler that writes to the outbox outside the transaction
Relay uses FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
Each consumer has its own SQS queue subscribed to the SNS topic
Consumers live in contexts/<ctx>/workers/ and delegate to a use-case
Dedupe by eventId never claims before processing; marks processed after success or in the same transaction
Mentions at-least-once delivery as the reason idempotency is required

evals.name: external-api-integration-acl
evals.prompt: Integra com a API da Acme pra emitir o boleto
evals.expected_output: Low-level AcmeClient in infrastructure/integrations/acme with typed AcmeApiError and resilience policy; adapter in contexts/<ctx>/adapters implementing a domain port; mapper; translation of business outcomes to Result.Err and availability faults thrown; idempotency key; per-vendor HttpModule
assertions: Separates low-level client (infrastructure/integrations/acme/) from the adapter/ACL (context adapters/)
Client throws a typed AcmeApiError, never a raw AxiosError
Adapter implements a domain port declared as abstract class in domain/
Vendor DTO shape does not leak into the domain
Business outcomes become Result.Err; timeouts, 5xx, 429 and open circuit are thrown
Sets a timeout and a circuit breaker that ignores 4xx business responses
Sends our own id as idempotency key

evals.name: cron-worker-batch
evals.prompt: Preciso de um job que roda a cada 5 minutos e reconcilia as recargas pendentes consultando o status na Acme.
evals.expected_output: workers/reconcile-recharges.cron.ts thin adapter with @Cron calling a batch use-case; use-case claims a batch safely for multiple replicas, loops with body extracted to a private method, logs start/branches/end, retry decision in a domain service
assertions: Cron adapter lives in contexts/recharges/workers/ and only schedules and calls the use-case
Cron adapter has no try/catch and no business logic
Use-case processes the batch in one execute() and extracts the loop body to a private method
Batch claim is safe across multiple ECS replicas (SKIP LOCKED lease or conditional transition)
One item's business failure is logged and does not abort the batch
Retry threshold decision is in the domain (domain service or entity), not in the use-case
Code follows braces/no-else/no-nested-if rules

evals.name: level-0-crud-stays-light
evals.prompt: Cria um CRUD de categorias de produto: nome, descrição e se está ativa. Listagem paginada e edição.
evals.expected_output: Declares level 0; contexts/product-categories with controller, DTOs, use-cases for create/update, domain/ with a plain type and repository port, TypeORM adapter, query service for the list; no value objects, no entity class with factory/restore, no AggregateRoot, no outbox, no workers
assertions: Declares the context as level 0 (no invariants, no integration)
Domain is a plain exported type plus an abstract-class repository port
No value object wrapping name or description
No AggregateRoot, no domain events, no outbox in the repository
No workers/ folder and no domain service
Use-cases still return Result and the controller returns it as-is
Listing uses a query service with DataSource and a capped page size
Code follows braces/no-else/no-nested-if rules
